title: Astra on the Skunk Works org chart

tellings.quote: Instead, what I saw above it was something called Astra.

plain: The writer Nick Cook says that sometime between 1993 and 1996 he saw an organisation chart of the Skunk Works, the secret aircraft design shop of the company Lockheed at Palmdale, California, with a box labelled "Astra" sitting above the rest. He tells Michels he saw it himself ("what I saw above it was something called Astra") and points to his diaries from the time. In a conversation about antigravity, he offers it as a hint that some hidden programme sat over the work everyone knew about.
